description: September 18 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 3, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 18 birthday falls in Virgo, in the third decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: September 18 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: As Virgo season heads towards its close, the 18th carries the birthday number 9, the last single digit and a symbol of compassion and endings. Twenty-five degrees of the sign places the Sun in Venus's decan, adding gentleness to Virgo's helpfulness. This date is often associated with people who look after others generously and who know when a chapter has quietly finished.

On September 18 the Sun usually sits at about 25° Virgo, in the third decan, where Venus is the sub-ruler alongside Mercury. Venus, ruler of Taurus, softens the last decan of Virgo, from roughly September 13 to September 22. The sign's practicality is joined by an eye for beauty, comfort and craft. Late-Virgo birthdays are often linked with gardening, design, cooking or any work where precision produces something pleasant to live with. Relationships may matter more than the classic Virgo stereotype suggests, and these natives tend to show love through thoughtful, tangible acts. Venus can encourage perfectionism about appearances too. Accepting that something can be lovely and unfinished at the same time usually brings this decan real ease.

sections.heading: September 18 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 18th reduces as 1 + 8 = 9, so the birthday number is 9. The compound pairs the 1's leadership with the 8's capacity to organise and manage, then turns both towards the 9's humanitarian outlook. Eighteenth-born people are often described as able to make a real difference: they can organise a fundraiser, run a team or argue a cause convincingly. Emotional openness may sometimes lag behind their practical help. This secondary number tends to suit those who use their influence for others rather than for status, and who measure success by what it changes.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one September 18 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22.

sections.heading: Born on September 18: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 18 is the 261st day of the year (262nd in a leap year). By September 23, 5 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Libra.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 18, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on September 18 include Anna Netrebko (1971), Samuel Johnson (1709) and Greta Garbo (1905).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 18?
faq.answer: September 18 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 18?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 18 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 2 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 22 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 18th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 18?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 18 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 18?
faq.answer: September 18 is also the birthday of Anna Netrebko (1971), Samuel Johnson (1709) and Greta Garbo (1905). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
